contracts.authority: uv release downloads (github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases): the sha256.sum checksum file a release publishes beside its archives
contracts.reason: Reads the SHA-256 of each archive of a declared uv release from the checksum file the release publishes, to answer the toolchain-resolve call. The file format belongs to the uv release process, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.
